csv_project_name: Design for Hinton Municipal Airport Rehabilitate Runway
csv_scope_of_work: The Oklahoma Department of Aerospace & Aeronautics may be seeking a consultant to provide a Design for Hinton Municipal Airport Rehabilitate Runway. The Overall Development Objective (ODO) of the proposed project is to rehabilitate runway. Existing runway pavement is exhibiting seasonal environmental distresses such as weathering, raveling, and longitudinal/transverse cracking. The pavement is at a point where it is more cost effective to rehabilitate than let it deteriorate until a point where reconstruction is required. Rehabilitation will include a crack seal and repair of more severe crack related distresses.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering

short_description: Design services for rehabilitating distressed runway pavement at Hinton Municipal Airport.
project_scope: Rehabilitation of the existing runway pavement at Hinton Municipal Airport. The runway shows seasonal environmental distress including weathering, raveling, and longitudinal/transverse cracking. Planned measures include crack sealing and repair of more severe crack-related pavement distress to avoid full reconstruction.
services: Consulting and design services for runway rehabilitation; requested disciplines include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, traffic design engineering, and landscape architecture.
